post.summary:
Documentation-only operation for the AIP-133 standard Create on the v2
threads collection (#5702). The handler lives in `thread_lifecycle` and
shares the legacy write path; only the URL and the `Location` response
header differ.
post.description: Create a thread at the end of the authenticated reader's queue. The created resource (including its stable `id`) is returned at 201 with a `Location` header naming the v2 collection member. The write preserves owner assignment, the five-second duplicate-merge guard and the Python validation envelope; it creates no Plan, dependency or issue rows.

201.description: Created (or the duplicate created seconds earlier)

delete.description: Delete an owned Thread (AIP-135). A second delete, or a delete of a foreign or already deleted Thread, returns 404. Never 403.

patch.description: Partially update an owned Thread (AIP-134). Omitted fields are preserved. When `update_mask` is supplied only its fields are applied; a masked field missing from the body is cleared. An `expected` precondition that no longer matches the committed row returns 409 with `detail.code = thread_edit_conflict` and the current values. Foreign or deleted Threads return 404, never 403.

404.description: Thread not found (including another reader's thread)

409.description: Stale `expected` precondition; reload before retrying

200.description: Paginated stored creator credits per mapped issue

AuditEvidenceEdge.description:
One inert legacy/converted dependency row into the frontier.

Source metadata is included only for issues the reader owns; a foreign
source keeps its stable row and issue identifiers but never a title,
number or status.

AuditListMembership.description: One owned Reading List placement of the frontier issue, with its gate.

BootstrapActiveThread.description: Currently pending thread shown by the Roll surface.

issue_number_alias.description: Alternate overall/story number for the same physical comic (#4652).

provider_issue_number.description: Provider's own issue number, only from a confirmed identity (#4652).

tags.description: Stored tag records; unknown stored columns are preserved via flatten.

BootstrapBandwidth.description: Compact bandwidth block retained for existing Roll consumers.

BootstrapIdentitySummary.description: Mapping state for a rollable candidate.

BootstrapIssueSummary.description: Candidate issue identity displayed on a Roll face.

BootstrapLastRead.description: Most recent rated issue for the active session.

BootstrapReaderStats.description: Reader statistics for one rollable face or canonical series run.

BootstrapResponseV2.description:
Full live `GET /api/v2/roll/bootstrap` payload.

This is the actual handler response type, so the generated contract and the
runtime share one authority. It is retained only until the bootstrap
retirement work removes the route; it is not a new feature surface.

snoozed_thread_ids.description:
Every owned thread in this browser's temporary snooze set, uncapped
within the cookie limit, so Queue can resolve per-row snooze state.

snoozed_threads.description:
Bounded display summary (at most 20 rows). Use `snoozed_thread_ids`
for the complete snooze set.

BootstrapRollRecovery.description:
Bounded recovery diagnostic shown when the pending issue is blocked.

The stable envelope is typed; each nested blocker/chain/diagnostic entry is
the existing bounded JSON node shape and remains extensible so no current
recovery detail is dropped from the live contract.

BootstrapRoute.description: One Roll route label attached to a rollable face.

BootstrapSessionMode.description: Legacy session-mode bridge retained on the live bootstrap contract.

session_mode_correction_guidance.description: Extension boundary: stored guidance JSON is passed through verbatim.

BootstrapTag.description:
One tag visible to the reader on a Roll thread row.

The stable stored tag columns are typed; `extra` preserves any additional
stored columns so future tag metadata is never silently dropped.

BootstrapThreadSummary.description: Owner-scoped thread summary shown by Roll snooze chips and rollable rows.

BoundaryEvaluator.description:
Deployment-level capability for the canonical evaluator behind this batch.

It mirrors the same `AppState::option_e` switch every handler resolves, so
a client that has already observed one batch can skip the canonical read
entirely on later loads when the evaluator cannot answer (`unavailable`)
and consult the legacy blocking authority directly.

CblComicvineOccurrence.description: One Comic Vine occurrence in the shared CBL catalog.

CblSourceEntryDetail.description: One ordered source occurrence inside a CBL list.

CblSourceListDetail.description: One active CBL source list with one bounded page of ordered occurrences.

ComicPileMatch.description: Owner-scoped local representations of a related ComicVine issue.

ComicVineMappingHealth.description: Compact confirmed ComicVine mapping health for one queue row.

next_offset.description:
`offset + results` can exceed `i32` at the accepted offset bound, so
paging arithmetic is widened (#4636390843).

accepted_alias_numbers.description:
Requested numbers the reader explicitly accepted as aliases of already
mapped issues instead of creating physical duplicates (#4654).

append_to_end.description: Explicit "At the end" choice. Distinct from an omitted anchor.

expected_issue_ids.description:
Issue IDs observed in the accepted preview. A changed set means the
preview is stale; the edit is refused before any write (#4654).

insert_after_issue_id.description: Explicit anchor. Omit for natural placement.

Creator.description: An issue's credited creator with stable provider identity and merged roles.

CsrfResponse.description: Response body carrying a double-submit CSRF token.

DemoRoll.description: The product-owned deterministic guest Roll fixture.

DependencyCreateRequest.description:
Flat wire request mirroring the Python `DependencyCreate` payload so the
Dependency Builder migrates without changing its semantics.

DependencyGroupCreateRequest.description: Wire request mirroring the Python `DependencyGroupCreate` payload.

DependencyGroupDetailMemberResponse.description: Wire response member mirroring the Python `DependencyGroupDetailMemberResponse`.

DependencyGroupIssueRangeCreateRequest.description: Wire request mirroring the Python `DependencyGroupIssueRangeCreate` payload.

DependencyGroupMemberCreateRequest.description: Wire request mirroring the Python `DependencyGroupMemberCreate` payload.

DependencyGroupUpdateRequest.description: Wire request mirroring the Python `DependencyGroupUpdate` payload.

DependencyResponse.description:
Issue-level dependency response mirroring the Python `DependencyResponse`
fields the Dependency Builder consumes (`warning`, labels, thread ids).

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: Request body for an enumeration-safe password-recovery email.

FrontierAuditFinding.description: One unprotected current unread frontier with its inert evidence.

legacy_evidence.description: Inert dependency rows into this frontier from an incomplete source.

list_memberships.description: Owned Reading List placements of the frontier issue and their gates.

FrontierAuditReport.description: The complete read-only audit response for one owner.

actionable_reader_prerequisites.description: Reader-authored prerequisites currently loaded with execution authority.

frontiers_examined.description: Live frontiers examined (active queued Threads, one next unread each).

frontiers_protected.description:
Examined frontiers an actionable Option E constraint currently blocks
(reader prerequisite or list order).

inert_evidence_counts.description: Those rows grouped by evidence class.

inert_evidence_rows.description: Inert dependency rows examined (owned unread target, incomplete source).

note.description: Report-only disclaimer; the audit is never an execution input.

unprotected_frontiers.description:
Examined frontiers with no actionable Option E constraint while inert
legacy evidence records possible reader intent: the reported gaps.

IdentityInboxConfirmRequest.description: Body for confirming an identity inbox candidate.

next_steps.description:
Actionable next steps for the reviewer when the match is unresolved,
ambiguous, or missing. Empty when no guidance is needed.

IdentityInboxPartialMatchIssue.description:
One issue in an explainable partial series match. When a stored candidate
exists, `mapping_id`/`external_identity_id` let the UI confirm it through
the existing confirmation endpoint; otherwise the issue stays for review.

IdentityInboxRejectRequest.description: Body for rejecting an identity inbox candidate.

no_match_reason.description:
Explainable reason when discovery found nothing, produced by the same
matcher that scores successful searches.

partial_matches.description:
Series-level partial matches derived from the same provider response.
Always emitted (empty when no volume resolves) for wire stability.

ImportIssueRequest.description:
Python `ImportIssueRequest`: `title` 1-200 characters (stored stripped),
`comicvine_issue_id > 0`, `issue_number` at most 50 characters, and the
optional reading-order ids `> 0`.

InitializeSessionRequest.description:
Temporary explicit write boundary for legacy reading-session consumers.
GET /api/v2/roll/bootstrap never creates or mutates a session.

IssueBulkRequest.description: Request body for the bulk read-state operations.

comicvine_issue_id.description: Confirmed provider issue identifier, never a provisional candidate.

cover_image_url.description: Exact provider-supplied CDN URL. Null when unmapped; never image bytes.

display_issue_number.description: Display number combining authored and alias when present.

has_confirmed_identity.description: Whether a confirmed ComicVine issue mapping exists.

issue_number.description: Authored issue number within the run (reader's label).

issue_number_alias.description: Alternate overall/story-arc number when the physical comic has dual numbering.

provider_issue_number.description: Provider's own issue number from confirmed identity metadata, when known.

issue_ids.description: Visible issue identifiers requested for one bounded batch.

items.description: Owned cards in first-request order; foreign or missing IDs are omitted.

IssueCreatorsEntry.description: Stored creator credits for one issue (Python `IssueCreatorsEntry`).

IssueEditAliasOffer.description: A source-preserving alternative to creating a new physical issue (#4654).

evidence.description: Concrete identity evidence, not a generic duplicate warning.

existing_issue_id.description: Existing identity-mapped issue that can be aliased instead.

requested_issue_number.description: Issue number the reader asked to add.

series_title.description: Human-readable series the existing issue belongs to.

alias_offers.description:
Source-preserving alternatives for numbers that already exist as
identity-mapped issues in another owned series (#4654).

expected_issue_ids.description: IDs shown in Before, echoed so the commit can reject a stale preview.

undo_session_id.description: Reading session that received the pre-edit undo point, if one is active.

undo_snapshot_id.description: Snapshot a reader can restore to reverse this committed edit (#4654).

after_issue_id.description: Move after this issue. `null` moves the issue to position 1.

IssueReadOperationItem.description: One issue affected by a bulk read/unread operation.

IssueReadOperationResponse.description: Reviewable, reversible record of a bulk read/unread operation (#4655).

IssueReadOperationUndoResponse.description: Result of undoing a bulk read/unread operation (#4655).

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated retry key. Same key/payload replays the same receipt.

issue_number_alias.description:
Alternate overall/story number for the same physical comic (#4652).
Set to a string to assign, empty string or null to clear. Omit to leave unchanged.

rating.description: Effective issue rating in 0.5-point steps. Omit to keep the stored rating.

source.description:
Source of the issue action. Omitted or "direct" is a manual read from a
Thread row: it never steps the die and never repositions the queue.
"roll_offer" is a Roll completion: it applies the Roll rating semantics
(die stepping, queue placement, and a link back to the originating offer
event) in the same transaction as the read.

status.description: Explicit new status. Omit to leave read state unchanged.

die_after.description: Die after this rating, when source is "roll_offer". Null for "direct" source.

ListCblOccurrencesResponse.description: One bounded page of exact Comic Vine occurrences in the shared catalog.

ListCblSourcesResponse.description: One bounded page of the shared source collection.

catalog_total.description: Whole active shared-catalog total, independent of folder or search.

page.description: Echoed effective page, kept for the browser's deep-linkable position.

total.description: Full match total for the applied folder/search scope, not this page.

ListReadingSessionsResponse.description: One bounded page of the canonical reading-session collection.

LoginRequest.description:
Request body for username/password login.

Login deliberately does not impose the registration minimum length: accounts
created before the current policy must still be able to sign in. An empty
password is rejected by bcrypt verification with the same non-enumerating
401 as any other incorrect credential, matching Python.

MinimalReleaseResponse.description: Minimal release data for reconciliation endpoints (no body).

PasswordResetResponse.description: Safe acknowledgement returned whether or not an account exists.

status.description: A linked plan is not eligible for destructive association changes.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation of the candidate's membership and order differences.

PoolReason.description:
Why the Roll pool has no in-play faces.

Derived from the already-loaded Option E inputs and the eligible frontier
set. This is a single reason, never a list or a whole-library report, and it
adds no database work: it exists so a genuinely non-empty library does not
render the false "reading queue is empty" state (#4441).

PreviewIssueItem.description:
Per-issue human-readable context carried in the preview payload so the
Before/After rows can identify a specific series, its list memberships,
identity/rating/read state and the Queue/Roll frontier it affects (#4654).

effect.description: Human-readable description of the order effect on this issue.

frontier_label.description: Human label for the Queue/Roll frontier affected by this issue, if any.

has_rating.description: Whether rating history exists for this issue.

is_duplicate.description: Whether a second physical issue with the same number exists in the series.

is_mapped.description: Whether the issue has a confirmed external identity/catalog mapping.

is_read.description: Whether the issue has already been read.

series_title.description: Title of the series (thread) this issue belongs to.

source_lists.description: Names of every custom reading list the issue is a member of.

PreviewIssueStructureRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v2/threads/{thread_id}/issues/structure-preview`.

Delete and reorder are structural issue edits too, so A4 requires the same
before/after, constraint and frontier preview that create/insert receives
(#4654). The operation is deliberately described by a string plus optional
fields rather than a tagged enum so an unsupported shape is a plain 400 and
never a deserialization-shaped 500.

issue_id.description: Issue to remove. Required for `delete`, ignored for `reorder`.

issue_ids.description: Every issue id in the requested order. Required for `reorder`.

operation.description: `delete` removes one issue; `reorder` applies a complete new order.

accepted_alias_numbers.description: Numbers the reader explicitly chose to alias instead of duplicating.

append_to_end.description: Explicit "At the end" choice. Distinct from an omitted anchor.

expected_issue_ids.description:
Issue IDs shown in the preview's Before rows. Used at commit time to
reject a stale preview (#4654).

insert_after_issue_id.description: Explicit anchor. Omit for natural placement.

strategy.description: Requested placement strategy. Defaults to safe_default.

PublicReleaseResponse.description: One release ledger record returned by public-facing endpoints.

QueueEntryPatch.description: Resource patch for one queue entry.

position.description: Target reader-visible ordinal. Ranks beyond the end place the entry last.

QueueEntryResponse.description: Queue entry resource returned by GET and PATCH.

ordering_version.description:
Content revision of the reader's current queue order.

Derived from the durable ordering state on every read, so it changes
whenever any writer changes the order and stays equal while the order is
unchanged. It is a change-detection token, not a persisted per-entry
counter and not the #3227 sparse order key.

thread_id.description: Canonical queue-entry identity: the owned Thread id.

QueueExclusionGroupRef.description: Bulk exclusion provenance attached to an excluded queue thread (#5435).

idempotency_key.description: Client retry key. Replaying a committed key returns the same revision.

replayed.description: True when an identical `idempotency_key` was already committed.

shuffled.description: Number of entries whose position this revision wrote.

QueueSeriesMetadata.description: Confirmed provider series metadata for one queue row.

ReadingGraphCycle.description: One cycle with its concrete edge path.

ReadingGraphEdge.description: One stored requirement that participates in a cycle.

ReadingGraphIssue.description: One issue endpoint as a reader sees it, never a bare database identifier.

ReadingGraphRepairOption.description: One owner-scoped repair the reader can preview and apply.

ReadingGraphRepairRequest.description: Flat wire request so a preview never depends on tagged-enum deserialization.

confirm.description: Preview by default. A repair applies only when this is explicitly true.

oneOf.description:
Read-only frontier audit (#4198): current unread frontiers that Option E
would offer while inert legacy/converted dependency evidence still
records possible reader intent. `null` while the graph is invalid or in
repair previews, which project in-memory states rather than stored data.

confirmed_predecessor_changes.description:
Creation has no predecessor changes to confirm; only update accepts
them. A present value is rejected exactly like the Python create path.

expected_updated_at.description:
Optimistic concurrency token. When present on update, the write is
rejected if the list changed since the client last read it.

ReadingModeResponse.description: Current reading-mode state for the active session (wire response).

ReadingModeSetRequest.description:
Set request: `source` is required; `answers` (quiz) or resolved
`bandwidth`+`intent` (manual) supplies the mode, as in Python.

ReadingOrderSummary.description: One row of the reading-orders list (Python `ReadingOrderSummary`).

ReadingSessionCreatedResponse.description: Result of the explicit v2 reading-session initialization write.

ReadingSessionResource.description: One durable, event-derived reading session in the canonical collection.

current_die.description: Event-derived die, with the legacy `manual_die` column as fallback only.

ladder_path.description: `start_die` followed by the session's recorded `die_after` values.

RefreshTokenRequest.description: Optional request body for token refresh; the refresh cookie is also accepted.

RelatedIssue.description: Related issue derived from a confirmed explicit story-arc relationship.

ReleaseListResponse.description: Paginated published releases for What's New.

ReleaseResponse.description: One complete release ledger record returned to trusted automation.

ReleaseSourceResponse.description: Result of reconciling a GitHub source identity with the ledger.

ReleaseUpsertRequest.description: Idempotent release publication payload from trusted automation.

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Request body for completing a password reset with a single-use token.

RollDieStateResponse.description: The reader's current logical die and the approved ladder.

default_die.description: The die an explicit reset returns to.

ladder.description: The approved dice ladder, smallest to largest.

oneOf.description: The most recent recorded roll, when the reader has rolled.

RollEligibleIssueIdsResponse.description: The ordered eligible issue identifiers for the current die.

die.description: The logical die that bounded the list.

issue_ids.description: The eligible issue identifiers, in queue order.

pool_reason.description:
Why an empty in-play pool has no faces, when it does.
Derived from the already-loaded Option E inputs and the eligible
frontiers before the die bound and browser snoozes, exactly as
`GET /api/v2/roll/bootstrap` reports it. `ready` means at least one
frontier is eligible; the other variants name why an empty pool has
no in-play faces (`no_series`, `all_blocked`, `all_completed`,
`all_out_of_pool`). It never carries a list or whole-library report.

thread_ids.description: The owning thread identifiers, parallel to `issue_ids`.

RollLastRoll.description: The most recent Roll recorded for this reader.

die.description: The die that produced the roll.

expected_pending_thread_id.description: A Queue action may only reroll the exact pending thread shown to the user.

idempotency_key.description: Stable client key; retries return the original offer without re-rolling.

snoozed_thread_ids.description: Threads this browser has temporarily snoozed (cookie authority only).

timezone.description: Browser timezone used only by the retained session bridge.

snoozed_thread_id.description: Thread snoozed by this request so the browser can extend its cookie.

RollOverrideRequest.description: Request body for the manual override.

RollPrerequisiteSwitchRequest.description: Request body for accepting one current recovery recommendation.

node_type.description: Recommended continuity-node type. Only concrete issues are accepted.

RollPrerequisiteSwitchResponse.description: Durable active-target state after accepting a recovery recommendation.

RollResponse.description: Response body: the Python `RollResponse` projection for a manual pick.

SessionDetailsResponse.description: Full session details response with events and narrative summary.

SessionEventDetail.description: Event detail for session details response.

StoryArc.description: A provider story arc with bounded related issues and a correct total.

ThreadCreatorCreditsResponse.description:
Bounded, paginated thread-scoped issue-credit projection for #5706.

Keeps the frozen per-issue `issue_id`/`creators` wire shape of the legacy
bulk creator read and adds standard page fields. The `issues` array omits
unmapped issues and issues without stored credits, exactly like the legacy
response, while `total_count` counts matching confirmed-mapping issue rows.

ThreadDependenciesResponse.description:
Wire parity with Python `ThreadDependenciesResponse`
(`app/schemas/dependency.py`): the `blocking` list holds edges where this
thread's issues block others, `blocked_by` holds edges where this thread's
issues are blocked. Each entry is the enriched `DependencyResponse`.

ThreadDetailResponse.description: The legacy single-thread response retained for the v1 and bare aliases.

oneOf.description: Present when this excluded thread was removed as part of a bulk action.

series_cover_image_url.description:
Derived series cover: the exact provider CDN URL of the thread's next
unread confirmed issue, falling back to the first confirmed issue with a
cover. Null when the series has no confirmed issue cover.

filtered_count.description: Total active Queue rows matching the applied search, independent of the bounded page.

ThreadPatchPrecondition.description: Committed values a stale client read before issuing a Thread patch.

manual_creator_credits.description: Manual creator credits observed by the client.

notes.description: Notes observed by the client; `null` means it observed no notes.

ThreadPatchRequest.description:
Body of `PATCH /api/v2/threads/{thread_id}`.

`update_mask` follows AIP-134: when supplied, only the named fields are
applied; a named field missing from the body is explicitly cleared. When it
is omitted or empty, every field present in the body is applied and every
omitted field is preserved (the legacy partial-update behavior).

oneOf.description:
Optional stale-client precondition. Every supplied value must still
match the committed row; otherwise the patch returns HTTP 409.

format.description: New format; normalized to the reader's canonical vocabulary.

is_test.description: Test-series flag. Omit to preserve it.

issues_remaining.description: Manual issue counter for untracked series (legacy queue transition).

manual_creator_credits.description: Manual creator credits. `null` clears them; names and roles are bounded.

notes.description: Notes. `null` or a blank string clears the stored value; omit to keep it.

title.description: New series title. Omitted fields are preserved.

update_mask.description:
Explicit field mask (AIP-134). Either an array of field names or one
comma-separated string. Omit for presence-based partial update.

ThreadResponse.description: The Python `ThreadResponse` projection every lifecycle writer returns.

ThreadTag.description: One tag visible to the reader.

TokenResponse.description: Response body for token endpoints, matching the Python wire contract.

UndoApplyResponse.description: Full session response matching Python SessionResponse.

UndoSnapshotItem.description: Snapshot item in the list response.

UnsnoozeRequest.description: Request body for unsnoozing a thread.

thread_id.description: The thread ID to unsnooze. Idempotent: an already-removed snooze succeeds.

UnsnoozeResponse.description: Response for unsnooze, mirroring the roll offer shape so the UI can rehydrate.

restored.description:
True when the pending roll and die were restored; false when only the
snooze was removed (older snooze, later die choice, or an already-removed
snooze replayed after a lost response).

UserPreferencesPatchRequest.description:
Partial update of the authenticated user's preferences.

`theme` is optional: when omitted or explicit JSON null the current
preference is left unchanged and a missing row is seeded with the
default, exactly like the Python `UserPreferencesPatchRequest`.

UserPreferencesResponse.description: Current preference values for the authenticated user.

UserResponse.description: Response body for the current-user endpoint.
